component.name: FlatBak
component.summary: Back up and restore your Flatpak applications

description.p: FlatBak makes one job easy: you reinstalled Linux, and you want your Flatpak applications and their data back.

Pick the applications to save, decide separately whether to include each one's data, and write everything to a single portable .flatbak file. On the new system, open that file, choose what to bring back, and FlatBak reinstalls the applications from their remotes and puts their data back where it belongs.
FlatBak is deliberately not a whole-system backup tool. It covers Flatpak applications and the data under ~/.var/app, and nothing else.
